fact: The minister for small and medium enterprises officially launched on 5 December 2025 in Brazzaville an online company-creation platform at www.acpce.cg, and the ACPCE director general said some promoters created their companies online during the launch ceremony.

Minister of SMEs Lydia Mikolo launched on 5 December 2025 a 100 percent online company-creation platform of the ACPCE, on which entrepreneurs file, track and pay fees online, with more than 5,300 firms created in 2025.
RFI reports the government has launched an online company creation platform run by the Agence congolaise pour la création des entreprises, with a company now creatable in 24 hours from anywhere.
